text:
If you’re eyeing a high-end e-bike to transform your daily commute, you might want to hold off on the upgrade for just a little longer. The rapid pace of battery technology and motor efficiency means that what is "cutting edge" today could be significantly outdated by next season. 

Instead of jumping into the latest model now, wait for the next wave of hardware updates. You’ll likely get much better range and lighter frames for the same price, making your investment far more future-proof.
